questions.prompt:
A + B means 'A' is the father of 'B'; A × B means 'A' is the sister of 'B'; A = B means 'A' is the daughter of 'B'.
If M = P × R, which statement is correct?

options.A: M is the son of R's sister
options.B: M is the son of R's brother
options.C: M is the daughter of R's sister
options.D: M is the daughter of R's brother

questions.rule: Read each sign in turn: M = P means M is the daughter of P, and P × R means P is the sister of R.
questions.working: M is the daughter of P, who is R's sister.

questions.prompt: 'A' is the grandfather of 'G' and 'E' is the daughter-in-law of 'A'. 'C' and 'D' are the only two children of 'B', 'F' is the husband of 'D'. 'G' is the son of 'C'. Then the brother of 'D' is

questions.working: C and D are the only two children of B, and F is D's husband, so D is a daughter. C, who has a son, is the brother of D.

questions.prompt:
A + B means 'A' is the father of 'B'; A × B means 'A' is the brother of 'B'; A = B means 'A' is the daughter of 'B'.
If P + Q = R, which statement is correct?
questions.rule: Read each sign in turn: P + Q means P is the father of Q, and Q = R means Q is the daughter of R.
questions.working: P is the father of Q and R is a parent of Q, so R is the mother and P and R are husband and wife.

questions.prompt: Father is 30 years elder than his son. After three years, the father's age becomes 3 times the son's age. What is the present age of the father in years?
questions.rule: Let the son be s now. The father is s + 30, and in 3 years s + 33 = 3 × (s + 3).
questions.working: s + 33 = 3s + 9, so 2s = 24 and s = 12. The father is 12 + 30 = 42.

questions.prompt: Preetham's age is twice the age of his sister Ankitha. Ankitha is 3 years younger than her brother Koushik. Koushik is 10 years old. Then the age of Preetham in years is
questions.rule: Work from the one age you know.
questions.working: Koushik is 10, Ankitha is 10 − 3 = 7 and Preetham is 2 × 7 = 14.

questions.prompt: The age of the father is 3 times the total age of his three children. After 6 years the age of the father will be twice the total age of his children. Then the present age of the father in years is
questions.rule: Let the children add up to c now. The father is 3c. In 6 years each of the three children is 6 older, so they add up to c + 18.
questions.working: 3c + 6 = 2 × (c + 18) = 2c + 36, so c = 30 and the father is 90.

options.A: Both I and II are correct
options.B: I is correct and II is wrong

questions.rule: Draw the groups as circles in every way the statements allow. A conclusion follows only if it is true in every drawing.
questions.working: The soldiers circle is inside the brave circle, so some brave men are soldiers. Only some ministers are soldiers, and some soldiers may not be ministers, so II does not follow.
